response.query: Studies on trade agreements and sustainable fisheries examining the impact of fisheries provisions within FTAs on marine sustainability using mean trophic level data (1950–2018) with difference-in-differences and propensity score matching; focus on environmental provisions, policy effects, and fisheries conservation outcomes.
response.answer: Studies show trade agreements with fisheries provisions impact marine sustainability, using mean trophic level data. Difference-in-differences and propensity score matching methods analyze environmental provisions' effects. Outcomes focus on fisheries conservation and sustainability.
